title: Notice to a hosting service under Article 16(2) of the Digital Services Act
notes: Maps the four elements a notice must contain to the fields of a platform_ip_report projection. Where the platform's form asks for the URL of the reported content on the platform itself, add it when filing; the projection carries the platform and the account identifier.

requirements.text: A sufficiently substantiated explanation of why the information is alleged to be illegal content
A clear indication of the exact electronic location of the information, and where necessary information that identifies it on the service
The name and email address of the individual or entity submitting the notice
A statement confirming the notifier's good-faith belief that the information and allegations in the notice are accurate and complete
